layout.change: Move units.player/target/focus.enabled into the Appearance band, drawn bespoke for the selected unit as 'Enable <Unit> bar'; key, default, alwaysPerUnit and onChange are kept. Side effects: Appearance Defaults now restores the enables, and /at list prints them under appearance.
layout.reason: options-ui-§14 makes enable a band act and §15 keeps per-instance settings on the instance's page; it must be the band, not a tab, because a linked unit's tabs are replaced by the hint (P22). Fixes P01, P02, P22.

layout.change: If L01 is taken, move throttleWindow to Master controls as an extra row on its own line, after Minimap button and before the reset pair; the Bars tab disappears. If L01 is declined, keep the Bars tab (renamed per L06) with both subsections.
layout.reason: §15 allows addon-wide extras there, and it avoids a one-slider tab. It is a judgement call because §15's example extra is a player-facing switch. Fixes P03.

layout.change: Merge the Size tab into Bar: subsection 'Size' (Bar width, Bar height) first, then subsection 'Fill' holding the BarGroup block unchanged.
layout.reason: Removes a one-line tab, and size and fill are read together. §16 keeps the block contiguous within its subsection. Fixes P05, P18.

layout.change: Merge Background into Bar as a third subsection 'Background' after Fill; the strip becomes Bar, Border, Text.
layout.reason: The backdrop is the empty part of the same bar, and fill and background colours are chosen against each other; §16 explicitly allows merging. Fixes P06.

layout.change: Relabel to 'Bar width (px)' / 'Bar height (px)', with tooltips 'Width of this bar, in pixels. Master scale (General) multiplies it.' and the same for height.
layout.reason: Sentence case, the collection's '(px)' form, and the tooltip names the multiplier. Fixes P07, P14.

layout.change: If the Bars tab survives, rename it to 'Tracking' and 'Tracked units' to 'Bars shown', and update the 'General > Bars' strings. If L01 is taken, the strings become 'Re-enable it on the Appearance page or with /at toggle %s.'
layout.reason: Ends the Bars/Bar near-collision; the way-back strings must follow the move. Fixes P04, P17.

layout.change: Relabel to 'Background texture', with tooltip 'Texture drawn behind the fill, across the whole bar.'
layout.reason: Sentence case, and drops the LSM jargon. Fixes P08, P09.

layout.change: Relabel 'Enable Player Bar' to 'Enable Player bar', and the same for Target and Focus.
layout.reason: Matches the addon's own 'Target bar' wording. Fixes P10.

layout.change: Relabel to 'Update throttle (sec)', with tooltip 'Fastest the bars repaint during a burst of changes. Applies to every bar. Lower = snappier but more CPU.' The %.2f sec readout is kept.
layout.reason: States the unit in the collection's form and states the scope. Fixes P11, P20.

layout.change: Use one word, 'link': checkbox 'Link to Player', hint 'Linked to Player — untick Link to Player above to customize.', button 'Copy from Player', with matching tooltips. The mirror row's label and desc follow.
layout.reason: Five names for one state become one, and the hint names the control to use. Fixes P12.

layout.change: Make the band one row for every unit with four quarter cells (Unit DD, Enable CB, Link CB, Copy BTN), leaving the cells empty for Player. This is a host-only change in UnitPanel.lua. Fallback: keep the two-row band and record the §14 deviation.
layout.reason: §14 says the band is one row, and the strip stops jumping when the picker moves off Player. The fit of the cells needs a look in the client. Depends on L01 and L10. Fixes P13.

layout.change: Add a composer tooltips override beside labels, so the Bar opacity tooltip can say it applies to the whole bar and is multiplied by Master alpha.
layout.reason: The canonical tooltip misdescribes this addon's row (P15). Upstream only.

layout.change: Write a tooltip per unit instead of using LABEL:lower(). Player: 'Show the Player bar and track absorbs on yourself.' Target: '...on your target. It appears only while you have a target.' Focus likewise.
layout.reason: Removes 'your player' and the target/focus sentence on the Player row. Fixes P19.

layout.change: With L01 taken, the Appearance tooltip becomes '...on every unit, including which bars are shown.' The General text is unchanged.
layout.reason: L01 widens what the button resets, and §13/§12 require the button to say what it resets. Fixes P21.

layout.change: The §14 escape: a first Appearance tab holding Link/Copy (and the enable).
layout.reason: disabledReplaces would replace the tab holding the unlink control, so it needs an OptionsTabs exemption; L11 gets one row without library work.

layout.change: Also merge Border into the Bar tab.
layout.reason: Four subsections and seven lines would scroll, and Border is its own tab in sibling addons.

layout.change: Rename the Text tab to 'Font'.
layout.reason: 'Text' says what is styled, and the name is a cross-addon decision.

layout.change: Move throttleWindow onto the Appearance page.
layout.reason: It is addon-wide; a per-unit page would imply a per-unit value.

layout.change: Rename 'Lock frame' to 'Lock bars', or move Master scale/alpha next to the per-unit rows.
layout.reason: These are fixed elements under §15 and are forbidden to change; listed upstream instead. Confidence n/a.

strata.change: Add bar:SetFrameStrata("MEDIUM") after CreateFrame, changing inherited MEDIUM to explicit MEDIUM. Same visual result today.
strata.reason: Makes the HUD tier a decision; the frames are non-secure, so the call is safe in combat. Fixes S01, S09.

strata.change: Move the border edge to a child frame bar.border (edge only, SetAllPoints, mouse disabled) at L+2. The bar keeps the background, and the fill keeps its 3 px anchor.
strata.reason: The border must sit above the fill (S02). Visible at borderSize > 3, so the owner needs a smoke look at 1, 3, 8 and 16.

strata.change: Re-host the value text on bar.border (or its own child) at L+3, from statusBar OVERLAY at L+1; the anchor is unchanged.
strata.reason: Without it, the Z02 border would draw over the text; text goes on top of the content stack. Depends on Z02.

strata.change: handle:SetFrameLevel(bar:GetFrameLevel()+5), from L+1. Confirm in the client that ? and X stay above it; upstream, add a levelOffset option to DragHandle.
strata.reason: The overlay gets a margin over any overlapping bar's content. Fixes S03, S04.

strata.change: Call bar:SetToplevel(true) so a dragged bar comes to the front while unlocked. Verify that the Z02-Z04 child offsets survive a raise. Alternative: fixed per-unit base levels.
strata.reason: Resolves the S03 interleaving while positioning.

strata.change: Call handle:SetIgnoreParentAlpha(true) and keep it a child of the bar; stub the method in wow_mock.
strata.reason: The move affordance must stay visible at 0% opacity (S05). Alpha rather than strata, but the same overlay rule.

strata.change: Add frame:SetToplevel(true) to the debug console and perf panel; it arrives through a re-vendor.
strata.reason: The two DIALOG tool windows need click-to-raise (S06, S07).

strata.change: Add a 'Layering' paragraph recording the tier table.
strata.reason: The next overlay should follow the stated intent instead of inheriting a level (S09).

strata.change: Reparent the drag handle to UIParent at L+5 so it escapes the bar's alpha.
strata.reason: It breaks show/hide, clamp and scale, and the level would have to track raises; Z06 does the same in one call.

strata.change: Inset the fill by the full borderSize instead of moving the border.
strata.reason: It changes the fill's size, which is beyond z-order.

strata.change: Raise the bars to HIGH strata.
strata.reason: There is no reported problem, and HIGH would draw over Settings and other windows.

layout.change: Retire the Display tab. Append Hide Blizzard buffs and Hide Blizzard debuffs to Master controls through the composer's extra slot (startsLine), after Test mode and before the reset pair. General page goes from 4 to 3 tabs. Trap: General.lua:93-94 overwrites effect on every composed row, so that loop must skip these paths or masterEffect must map them to "none".
layout.reason: Both rows are addon-wide display switches, which is exactly what options-ui-§15's extra slot is for. A 2-row tab costs a click for nothing.

layout.change: Fallback if Master controls stays canonical-only: rename Display to Blizzard frames and drop the subgroup that would repeat it.
layout.reason: The tab name says what the tab is, and the heading that only named the tab goes.

layout.change: Merge Sorting into Filters → General: Cast by, Duration, Max duration and Preset under What to show, then Sort by, Direction and Max auras under Order and cap. Filters goes from 5 to 4 tabs. Overrides' before = G_SORT becomes "after Categories", and the test moves with it.
layout.reason: One tab answers which auras survive, how many and in what order. Three rows did not earn a tab.

layout.change: Move the Where spell lists don't apply section from Situations to the top of Categories. The Spell Categories NOTE reads "(see above)" and the Overrides NOTE reads "(see Categories)". Carries L29.
layout.reason: The choice is about the grid drawn under it, so the player no longer leaves the tab. Cost: Categories grows by 3-6 lines.

layout.change: Rename the first heading from Unit type to Which units. The tab keeps the name Situations, stays last, and Which units stays at the top.
layout.reason: The heading no longer repeats its first row's label.

layout.change: Only with L03: rename the tab from Situations to Conditions.
layout.reason: It names "when does this container show at all", but Situations is the owner's merged feature name and still fits the zones.

layout.change: Move the Filter priority logic block from the foot of General to the foot of Overrides (after Blacklist), wording unchanged.
layout.reason: The ranks are the Overrides lists and the Categories grid, and General's rows are not ranked. Counter-weight: this reverses a placement batch 8 made from the owner's screenshots.

layout.change: Shorten the three Sorting tooltips to one sentence each, and draw the shared engine-group paragraph once, as a gray note under Order and cap.
layout.reason: One explanation, read once, instead of three copies in three hovers.

layout.change: Relabel Max duration as Max duration (s, 0 = no limit).
layout.reason: Shows the unit and the sentinel, as the sibling sliders already do.

layout.change: Reorder Screen mode to Screen anchor point | This container anchor point, then X position | Y position, and rewrite the two point tooltips to the new names.
layout.reason: Same order and words as the two attached modes; positions are named as positions.

layout.change: Merge Anchor and Growth into one Position & growth tab: Attach to, the mode subsections and Offset, then a Growth subsection with the inherited-flow note above it and the facing-growth hint under it ("…below"). Layout goes from 5 to 4 tabs. Needs a new UI-refresh onChange on Grow horizontally and Grow vertically, and the strings that name the old tabs reworded.
layout.reason: The hint and the inherited-flow note both describe the anchor-growth pair: one tab, no switching. At most 13 rows plus notes.

layout.change: Rename the Frame tab to Scale & strata.
layout.reason: Names its rows and stops clashing with Named frame and Frame name.

layout.change: Put Click-through first, then subsections Tooltips (Show tooltips, Tooltips in combat, Tooltip position) and Clicks (Right-click to cancel).
layout.reason: The override comes first, and options-ui-§7 wants subsections on a tab that mixes subjects.

layout.change: In every text-element tab (Bars Name/Time/Stack text, Icons Time/Stack text), move Show to the first row, alone on its line, ahead of the Font block.
layout.reason: The switch sits above what it switches, as Layout → Label already does.

layout.change: Relabel Placement's Anchor as Anchor point.
layout.reason: No clash with Layout's tab name, and it matches Layout's "…anchor point".

layout.change: Move Pandemic's Time color rows to Time text and Highlight to Bars General / Icons Cooldown, removing the Pandemic tab.
layout.reason: Rejected: B2-1 put both features on one tab as the owner's call, the Highlight tooltip's "set above" would break, and Time text would grow to 15 rows.

layout.change: Rename Size to General and append Cooldown's five rows under a Cooldown subsection. Icons goes from 6 to 5 tabs. The S-1 note is rewritten with it.
layout.reason: All three styles open on General. This reverses S-1's recorded decision not to match the styles' tab shapes.

layout.change: Change the Blizzard countdown numbers tooltip to say it also shows the game's countdown and needs Show cooldown swipe. Text only, no disabledIf.
layout.reason: The row does nothing with the swipe off, and today nothing says so.

layout.change: Move Countdown (Time format) from Font to General → Text template, after Custom template and before Preview.
layout.reason: Time format shapes the template's duration tokens and shows in the Preview right under it.

layout.change: Merge Pandemic and Animation into one Effects tab with subsections Pandemic window and Loop. Font keeps Font, Glow and Dispel type. Text goes from 5 to 4 tabs, and the pandemic note moves to the subsection's tail.
layout.reason: Both blinks sit side by side, and two 4-row tabs become one.

layout.change: Order the tab Size (+ fit note), Text template (Template, Custom template, Time format, Preview), Placement (+ notes), then the Tokens/Rules cheat sheet last under Template reference.
layout.reason: Controls come first and reference text last, and the template stays next to Size, which Size to fit measures from.

layout.change: Relabel Glow's Offset X / Offset Y as X offset / Y offset.
layout.reason: One spelling across the addon.

layout.area: General tabs, Filters grid headings, Text subsection
layout.change: Use sentence case: Spell categories, Dispel colors, Text template, Blizzard categories, Dispel types, Who cast it, and every string that quotes them.
layout.reason: Every other tab and heading in the addon is sentence case.

layout.change: Rename the rail style entries Bar / Icon / Text to Bar style / Icon style / Text style, and update Style's tooltip to match.

layout.change: Rename rail General's one tab from General to Container.

layout.change: Every cross-page reference reads "the General page -> …", and the Filters/Text references change with L03/L18.

layout.change: Rewrite the Filters and Layout rail tooltips to list every tab the entry holds.

layout.change: Relabel Preset as Max duration preset.

strata.change: Change the tooltip to warn that Dialog shares its layer with popups and the debug console, that High can draw over the settings window, and that Medium or lower is usual. Text only; the value list stays.
strata.reason: States the S01 collisions, including the HIGH case on migrated v1 profiles, without touching a setting.

strata.change: Set area to anim+1 and iconBorder to anim+2.
strata.reason: Same determinism rule as Z02. The two do not overlap today.

strata.change: No value change: express the glow floor and gap through the Z01 table, with the "holders below L" note beside it.
strata.reason: Same ladder, with the S11 exception documented.

strata.change: Document that the pandemic wash is drawn over the border and dispel edge on purpose, or move it to ARTWORK.
strata.reason: Rejected: an owner call with no evidence of a visible fault. Raise it with the owner; do not plan it.

strata.change: For S10, list containers whose strata differ from the others.
strata.reason: Rejected: stored data, and a diag line is a feature, not strata hygiene. Z07 covers the explanation.

conventions.rule: Keybindings tab is the LAST General tab, labelled exactly 'Keybindings', drawn as a host tab with no 'before' (LootHistory: last GENERAL_TABS build entry); rows in Bindings.xml order with the primary window toggle first; bindings are not schema rows; a one-row Keybindings tab is legal.
conventions.reason: 5 of 7 windowed-addon files chose last (BL, DPS, LH, QC, WG) vs 2 second (DW, MM); last is the only slot that displaces no fixed or owner-decided tab; QC is the only Bindings.xml with the toggle last and 015 rewrites it anyway.

conventions.rule: Keybindings tab opens with one library-default intro line ('Key bindings are saved by the game, not in your profile. Defaults and Reset all settings leave them alone.'); the General header Defaults tooltip ends 'Key bindings are not changed.' and, where it is the global reset, uses the same profile-reset wording as Reset all settings.
conventions.reason: DPS-L16 and WHA-L14 each proposed half in different words; a Keybindings tab beside a Defaults button invites the wrong expectation; WG/PGFE found General Defaults tooltips that overstate the reset.

conventions.rule: Binding labels: 'Toggle <window's own name>', no article, no addon brand (the per-addon category carries it); extra bindings are verb phrases.
conventions.reason: BL, DPS, WG, DW asked for one pattern; under a brand-named category the brand in the label repeats. Item 015 owns the final strings.

conventions.rule: A host never rewrites the label or tooltip of a MasterControls-composed row; addon-specific detail goes through an upstream composer 'notes' field (one appended sentence); per-addon composed-tooltip changes wait for it, and existing host overrides migrate to it.
conventions.reason: DPS-L12 rejected host rewrites as options-ui-§15 drift while BAN, CON, LH, PFE and WG proposed them; the composer is documented as the only writer of that text.

conventions.rule: Addons whose unlocked view is the preview (no Test mode row) share one canonical Lock frame tooltip variant from the composer (lockIsPreview).
conventions.reason: PAR-P18 and CON-L15 found the preview undiscoverable; ABS and KIC have the same shape; one sentence for four addons.

conventions.rule: Sentence case for row labels, tabs, subsections, grid/column headings, rail entries and button text; Title Case only for sidebar page names, proper nouns and entity names shown as list entries.
conventions.reason: options-ui-§15's canonical names are sentence case; every file found Title Case strays and none proposed the reverse.

conventions.rule: Two-subject tab names join with 'and', never '&'.
conventions.reason: 13 uses of 'Size and position', 4 of 'Background and border'; AuraMaster and PFE hold the only ampersands.

conventions.rule: Unit suffixes '(px)', '(seconds)' ('(seconds left)' allowed), '(%)', '(degrees)', '(characters)', '(item levels)'; sentinel joins the unit: '(px, 0 = automatic)'; never '(in px)', '(in seconds)', '(sec)', '(s)'; value readout fmt untouched.
conventions.reason: '(px)' is the composer canonical and majority; '(seconds)' is what DW, CM, QC, PFE ship; '(s)', '(sec)' and '(in ...)' are single-addon forms.

conventions.rule: 'X offset'/'Y offset' (object first when needed: 'Label X offset (px)'); positions 'X position'/'Y position'; 'Maximum' spelled out.
conventions.reason: 10+ uses of 'X offset'; drift found in AuraMaster, ConsumableMaster and MultiMeters.

conventions.rule: Every host row says 'opacity'; 'alpha' only in canonical Master alpha pending upstream.
conventions.reason: BL, CM, KIC, MM, PAN reported the split; canonical Bar opacity already says opacity; strays are QC Faded alpha and KIC Ready/Cooldown alpha.

conventions.rule: Instance rows a Master row multiplies name their object (Pad scale, Window scale, Container scale); their tooltips end 'Multiplied by Master scale (or Master alpha) on General > Master controls.'
conventions.reason: QUI-L36 and DRO-L09 named the object; ABS-L05, AUR-L25, CON-L30, LOO-L12 wrote the multiplier note four ways.

conventions.rule: Location strings read '<Page> > <Tab>[ > <Subsection>]' with ASCII ' > ', say 'the General page' when ambiguous, quote controls by exact label; renames grep modules/, core/, locales/ too.
conventions.reason: '>' is the majority; AuraMaster uses '->' and BL/LH/PAN use the U+25B8 triangle; ABS, AUR, BL found tab names outside settings/.

conventions.rule: Dependent rows' tooltips say 'Needs <exact row label>.' plus '(<Page> > <Tab>)' when the parent is elsewhere; 020 adds or removes no disabledIf.
conventions.reason: LOO-L05, AUR-L16, PAR-L04/L15 phrased the same dependency three ways.

conventions.rule: Per-instance enable/link/copy live on the instance's page: in the band on ONE row beside the picker (height independent of selection) or on the §14 General escape; a row drawn on a page is stamped to that page so that page's Defaults owns it.
conventions.reason: options-ui-§14/§15; ABS-L01 re-stamped while KIC-L01 kept panel='general', leaving General's Defaults resetting rows not shown there; DW, DPS, MM accept the same Defaults consequence for page moves.

conventions.rule: Link vocabulary: 'Link to <Source>' checkbox, 'Copy from <Source>' button, hint 'Linked to <Source>. Untick Link to <Source> above to give this unit its own look.'
conventions.reason: Five names for one concept in AbsorbTracker, three in KickCD; short labels make the one-row four-cell band fit.

conventions.rule: Instance acts name their object: 'New/Duplicate/Delete/Reset <noun>', no article, Delete last; checkboxes on the selected instance read 'Enable this <noun>' / 'Unlock this <noun>' using the band picker's noun.
conventions.reason: MultiMeters and QuickComms already ship the act pattern; PanelMaster proposed 'Enable/Unlock this panel'; bare 'Enabled', 'Delete', 'Reset' are the strays.

conventions.rule: A button that opens a confirmation ends in '…' (canonical Reset all settings exempt pending upstream).
conventions.reason: BL and DPS already do; DW, LH and BL Clear all do not; DRO-P13 and LOO-P18 asked for the rule.

conventions.rule: A tab with a surface's size and anchor/offsets is 'Size and position', subsections Size, then Position, then Layer; a multi-cell arrangement tab is 'Layout'.
conventions.reason: KickCD, MultiMeters, PFE say 'Size and position', size first; PanelMaster is the single 'Position and size'; PAR-L06 was held back for this reason.

conventions.rule: One tab per styled surface: a status bar's tab is 'Bar' with Fill, Background, Border subsections; block order Size, Fill, Font, Background, Border, then effects; 'Background color' under 'Background'; border toggle 'Show border'; composed font block keeps §16 labels (a color label may name its text only when the block colors one of several texts).
conventions.reason: §16 allows the merge; the files produced three shapes for one bar (ABS separate Border tab, PFE 'Bar and border', MM 'Bar style'); 'Bar' is shortest, repeats no subsection, and ABS already uses it.

conventions.rule: A tab styling a surface's text is 'Text'; its Show toggle is the first row of the block it governs; content toggles sit in a subsection before Font, never as Font-block extras.
conventions.reason: AUR-L12, KIC-L14, PAR-L03 reached it independently.

conventions.rule: Label 'Frame strata', paired with Frame level under a Layer subsection (AuraMaster: 'Scale and strata' tab), with one shared library tooltip string whose wording item 030 decides.
conventions.reason: MM, PFE, PAN say 'Frame strata', AuraMaster says 'Strata'; PAN-L20 and MUL-L22 wrote separate tier sentences.

conventions.rule: A tab holds at least two lines unless it is a page's only tab, the Keybindings tab, or a host editor; a one-row subsection only when its heading adds meaning; a tab's leading master switch sits unheaded above the first subsection.
conventions.reason: Every file merged lonely tabs; PGFE-L01 added a one-row heading over a lead switch while LOO-L10 removed one over the same shape.

conventions.rule: Master controls 'extra' only for addon-wide player-facing switches (≤2 rows, e.g. Preview as, Hide Blizzard buffs/debuffs); performance knobs go on a General tab named 'Behavior'; simulator/dev knobs are never extras.
conventions.reason: options-ui-§15 extras bullet; files split (ABS-L02, PRE-L09 yes; BAN-L02, MUL-L24, DPS no); MM and QC already ship General > Behavior.

conventions.rule: 'Simulation step delay (seconds)' under a heading or tab named exactly 'Simulator'; the slash verb goes in the tooltip ('Paces /<slash> sim: …'), never the heading.
conventions.reason: BAN-L02b required LH to mirror; a slash command in a heading/tab label in one addon only would break parity.

conventions.rule: Data-lifetime tab 'History': 'Keep history for' (or a count), storage readout, then 'Purge history…' last, no builder 'Danger zone' heading; account-wide rows' tooltips open 'Account-wide: shared by every profile.' with no label suffix.
conventions.reason: BL and LH converged; DW says Retention/Clear history and DPS Delete all runs under a §7-violating builder heading; a label suffix would lengthen four labels.

conventions.rule: BankLedger/LootHistory shared shape: tab order Master controls, Capture, Filters, (AH Pricing), Interface, History, Keybindings; 'Record …' verbs; 'Minimum quality'; Blacklist/Whitelist sub-tabs with blurb, IdList, then 'Clear all…' last; shared blurb closing sentences.
conventions.reason: The two addons share five tabs on purpose; LOO-L08, BAN-L11, BAN-L12/LOO-L16 and BAN-L05/LOO-L14 were each proposed for one side only.

conventions.rule: Per-instance visibility and fade sit under a 'Visibility' subsection on the instance's General tab; value texts match the composer's General visibility; toggle 'Fade unless hovered', slider 'Faded opacity'.
conventions.reason: QuickComms shipped it at the owner's request (2026-10-20); CON-L05/L06/L14 adopt it; PanelMaster labels the same toggle differently.

conventions.rule: Page Defaults tooltips list what they reset and are rewritten with any move; railed pages say 'Restore every tab of the entry selected on the left, for the <instance> in the band, to its defaults.'
conventions.reason: options-ui-§13 keeps Defaults page-wide; DW, QC, KIC found stale tooltips; only KIC proposed railed wording though AuraMaster and MultiMeters are railed too.

conventions.rule: One-shot test buttons are 'Test <thing>', never bare 'Test'; 'Preview' is reserved for drawn previews; list tabs are named for what they list.
conventions.reason: PRC-L19, WHA-L08, QUI-L08 reached it separately.

conventions.rule: Copy-from section is 'Copy settings from'; labels and tooltip name exactly what is and is not copied.
conventions.reason: AUR-L30, MUL-L19, PAN-L07 each found copy wording that over- or under-promised.

conventions.rule: First tab of a feature page or rail entry holding its switch/identity/acts is 'General' (including a rail entry's single tab); a non-first tab gets a real name.
conventions.reason: PFE, KIC, QC, AuraMaster style entries and MM all open on General; AUR-L23 would be the lone exception.

conventions.rule: Two-point anchors: '<Target> anchor point' | '<This element> anchor point', target first; a single screen anchor is 'Screen anchor point'.
conventions.reason: '<X> anchor point' and target-first are the majority of shipped labels (AuraMaster two modes, KickCD cast bar order); KickCD proposed a third form.

conventions.rule: Shared GLOW_KNOBS: glow headings name what glows; KIC-L29's 'offset' to 'reach' rename lands in KickCD, DropWatcher and QuickComms together or not at all.
conventions.reason: One knob must not be an offset in one addon and a reach in another.

conventions.rule: Out of item 020: adding/removing disabledIf, new buttons/acts, data-driven state markers, appearing/disappearing notices; file them as issues.
conventions.reason: Owner rule is move/regroup/relabel with behaviour untouched; AUR, PAN, PGFE already rejected dims on this ground.

conventions.rule: Unique change-id prefix per addon: PrettyChat uses PRC- (its file's PRE- collides with PremadeGroupsFilterExtension's PRE-).
conventions.reason: PRE-L01 exists in both files; commit-subject ids must be unambiguous for resume-state.

strata.libka0s: Yes, a small additive change. No new module and no tier constants table. LK-01: SetToplevel(true) on the DebugLog console, PerfPanel and SimPanel (DebugLog.lua:536, PerfPanel.lua:186, SimPanel.lua:211). In the same change each window's OnShow re-raises any shown StaticPopup, so a tool window opened after a confirmation never covers it, and a suite pin asserts the three windows are DIALOG and toplevel. CopyWindow is left out on purpose: a toplevel FULLSCREEN window would rise over QuickComms' FULLSCREEN modal band when it shows. 65%, asked for by 9 of the 15 analyses. LK-02: lib.DragHandle spec gets two optional fields (DragHandle minor 5). `level` is an offset over the parent, applied before the help and close marks are built, plus a handle:ApplyLevel() method. `ignoreParentAlpha` is a boolean. 70%, needed by AbsorbTracker, AuraMaster, ConsumableMaster, KickCD and QuickComms. LK-03: SetClampedToScreen(true) on the Widgets dropdown menu and the autocomplete list. 75%. LK-04: close the OptionsIds suggestion list from the combat cover's __releaseOwnedFocus, only after an in-client check. 45%. LK-05 is optional and deferred to a LibKa0s issue: a `strata` option on the DebugLog, PerfPanel and CopyWindow descriptors, for QuickComms and PGFE only. 40%. Rejected: a published lib.STRATA / Core.LAYERS tier table. It carries no behaviour, every addon still needs its own level table, and a library minor could then re-tier 15 addons, while the standard owns the tier keys. W.ContextMenu, a StaticPopup lift-while-shown helper and LevelOf go to open-evolutions. LibKa0s's own strata choices already fit the model. Its only defects are the missing toplevel, the missing clamps, the DragHandle having no level or alpha option, and the IdList list outliving the combat cover.

conventions.rule: Strata separates roles (HUD, edit chrome, windows, alerts, modals, child windows, popups, cursor). Frame level orders frames within one role. An addon never relies on a level race against another owner's frame in the same strata.
conventions.reason: A level race against Blizzard or another addon is not winnable by construction. QC-06 and DRO-S03 show the failure, and every analysis converged on the same split.

conventions.rule: T0 non-visual frames (event frames, binding click targets, ESC proxies, measurers, hidden parents) set no strata or level and are exempt from audit.
conventions.reason: They are never drawn. DpsRace, WhatGroup and KickCD analyses asked for an explicit exemption so audits stop flagging them.

conventions.rule: T1 HUD display: the root calls SetFrameStrata(LAYERS.STRATA.HUD), default MEDIUM, in the same block as its CreateFrame, and children inherit. A player-facing strata choice offers BACKGROUND/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH only. A knob shipped earlier keeps its stored values (DIALOG included), and its tooltip says that DIALOG covers the addon's popups, the console and the Settings window.
conventions.reason: Where the tier is only inherited, it was never decided (ABS-S01). DIALOG HUDs cover their own modals (AUR-S01, MUL-S03, PAR-S06). Value-set changes are forbidden in 020.

conventions.rule: A host-matched surface reads its host's strata (host:GetFrameStrata()) or inherits it, never restates it as a literal, and raises its level by a named offset over the host. A decorating element copies the host frame's strata and stacks one level over the host's highest readable descendant, with the read guarded.
conventions.reason: PGFE restates FULLSCREEN, which breaks if PGF changes (PRE-S01). PFE RangeFade is the working pattern.

conventions.rule: T2 edit chrome (handles, outlines, overlaying markers, unlock-only grips) lives in the display's strata at the top of the display band, above every overlapping display of the same addon. Mouse-enabled chrome is floored at max(display, MEDIUM). Mouse-off chrome MAY float at max(display, HIGH). Both use SetFixedFrameStrata, re-lifted after every parent strata write, and a lift never goes below the parent. Drag affordances ignore the parent's alpha. A drag backplate sits at the root level under the elements. Order within chrome: outline < marker < handle.
conventions.reason: Buried or tied handles (AUR-S02, PAN-S04, KIC-S06, ABS-S03/S04, CON-S08). A plate over its bars (PAR-S01). A handle that fades with content (ABS-S05). A HIGH floor on mouse-enabled chrome would cover the Settings panel (AuraMaster review).

conventions.rule: T4 windows: movable windows call SetToplevel(true). Persistent windows sit at MEDIUM and on-demand browsers at HIGH. A window whose frame takes no mouse calls Raise() on drag start. Documented exceptions: the secure fixed point (a window sharing the addon's modal strata is never toplevel or raised) and the event-raised notice previewed from Settings (DIALOG, not toplevel, Raise on explicit show).
conventions.reason: No Ka0s window is toplevel except DpsRace Results, so same-tier windows are ordered by accident (BAN-S01, LOO-S04, DRO-S05, MUL-S02, DPS-S01). QuickComms and WhatGroup need the two exceptions.

conventions.rule: T5 alerts: an interactive toast sits at HIGH. A non-interactive screen alert sits at FULLSCREEN with the mouse disabled, never in the popup strata.
conventions.reason: DropWatcher toast tier (DRO-Z08). DpsRace's countdown tied with menus at FULLSCREEN_DIALOG (DPS-S02).

conventions.rule: T6 modals and tool windows: DIALOG, toplevel, clamped. A toplevel tool window re-raises any shown StaticPopup when it shows, so a destructive confirmation is never buried. An addon that lets the player put its frames at DIALOG or above keeps its own confirmations answerable without permanently re-strata'ing shared Blizzard frames.
conventions.reason: There are four DIALOG peers and none is toplevel (MUL-S08, BAN-S05, KIC-S09). PrettyChat S02 shows that toplevel alone would bury popups. PanelMaster S05.

conventions.rule: A window opened from another window sits at least one strata above its opener. The detached child window (copy window) is FULLSCREEN over a DIALOG opener.
conventions.reason: The LibKa0s CopyWindow is the existing reference (Widgets.lua:651). The invariant BankLedger and LootHistory already follow.

conventions.rule: T8 transient popups sit at FULLSCREEN_DIALOG. They are clamped, close on every path their opener closes, and are dismissed by a GLOBAL_MOUSE_DOWN listener that ignores presses inside the popup. No full-screen click catcher. A HUD popup goes one strata above its HUD root (or at its Blizzard equivalent's strata), is set once at construction and is clamped like its root.
conventions.reason: Row menus outlive their windows and catchers swallow clicks (LOO-S01/S02, BAN-S03/S10). Unclamped menus (LOO-S09). The ConsumableMaster flyout is set per refresh and unclamped (CON-S02/S07).

conventions.rule: T9 cursor: tooltips, drag ghosts and overlays that label the frame under the cursor sit at TOOLTIP. Drag-time full-screen highlights sit at FULLSCREEN_DIALOG.
conventions.reason: AuraMaster's frame picker must clear the hovered frame's tooltip, while its snap highlight only needs to clear the user strata (AUR-S07).

conventions.rule: Pick the secure tier first. A secure frame that shows in combat has its strata fixed first, and the insecure stack moves up around it. A window sharing the addon's modal strata is never toplevel or raised.
conventions.reason: QC-06 shows it: the dial header's strata is protected in combat, and Raise lifts a window over a modal's catcher (PreviewWindow.lua:35-38).

conventions.rule: Element ladder inside one display element: root regions < FILL (+1: fill, swipe, spark) < BORDER (+2) < EFFECT (+3: glow hosts, with an explicit small frameLevel passed to Glow.Start) < OVERLAY (+4: one mouse-off overlay frame for text, marks, veils and washes). The order is a MUST and the offsets a SHOULD. Addon-specific classes slot between rungs.
conventions.reason: Seven addons layer their buttons and bars inconsistently (KIC-S01/S02, CON-S03/S04, AUR-S03/S13, QUI-S01/S02, PAR-S02, ABS-S02, DRO-S06). One order makes them consistent within and across addons.

conventions.rule: A region never has to draw over a child frame of its own frame. Anything that marks or overlays a child frame lives on its own mouse-off overlay child frame at the top of the element's band. Over a clickable or secure button, that frame is EnableMouse(false).
conventions.reason: A child frame draws over all of its parent's regions. This is the most common defect found (KickCD text under the swipe, MultiMeters highlights under cells, ConsumableMaster wash under the buttons, QuickComms veils under the glows, PFE text under the border).

conventions.rule: No absolute levels: every level is base:GetFrameLevel() + LAYERS.LEVEL.X, and never relative to a sibling. A player-chosen level is a base. Measured levels (combat cover, PFE host walk) are relative by construction. Levels under restricted anchors are read through a secret-safe guard.
conventions.reason: Magic and sibling-relative numbers are scattered across files (AUR-S06, QUI-S04, MUL-S07, PRE-S07). PFE has a level written once against a moving base (PAR-S03).

conventions.rule: One layers table per addon: NS.Constants.LAYERS = { STRATA = {...}, LEVEL = {...} } in core/Constants.lua, keyed by the standard's tier keys (HUD, CHROME, HUD_POPUP, WINDOW, ALERT, SCREEN_ALERT, MODAL, CHILD, POPUP, CURSOR). Its header comment states the whole stack, library tiers included. No strata string or bare level number at a call site. A single-call addon MAY use one named local. ARCHITECTURE.md points at the table instead of copying it. A frameless addon calls none of these APIs and pins that with a static test.
conventions.reason: Strata literals at call sites collided while each was locally right (DRO-S04, LOO-S07, BAN-S06, KIC-S10). Copied layering comments went stale (MUL-S04/S05, BAN-S04, LOO-S06). PrettyChat shows the frameless shape.

conventions.rule: Overlapping siblings that both draw never tie: they get explicit distinct levels. Siblings that draw nothing and take no mouse, or are kept apart by documented geometry, need no band.
conventions.reason: Creation-order ties (KIC-S02, DPS-S04, AUR-S04/S05, PAN-S01/S02). QuickComms and WhatGroup reviews rejected bands added for non-problems.

conventions.rule: Re-assert what moves. Set an explicit level again after every SetParent and wherever the base is re-levelled, never only in a memoized restyle. Set a level before children are built. A child with its own strata is SetFixedFrameStrata(true) and re-lifted after every parent strata write. Sunk art is re-sunk when its parent is re-levelled.
conventions.reason: SetParent re-derives the level (KIC-Z06). A parent's strata write resets its children (AUR-S12). A memoized Reskin never runs on restack (PAR-S03). PGFE sinkToParentLevel.

conventions.rule: Peers stack whole. Frames of one kind that can overlap get a defined order: toplevel or Raise on interaction, or a deterministic per-instance base with stride >= the band height. Player-equal levels MAY interleave if the setting's tooltip says so.
conventions.reason: Peer bars, windows and panels interleave rung by rung (ABS-S03, MUL-S02, PAN-S03, KIC-S04/S11, PAR-S04/S10).

conventions.rule: Library bands are part of the addon's map: grip +10, reorder drop line +20, reorder box -1, combat cover computed. A window's content stays at or below +8, and degraded fallbacks reproduce the library's offsets.
conventions.reason: Grip headroom is undocumented (DPS-S07, DRO-S07). Degraded grips drift (BAN-S07, LOO-S08).

conventions.rule: Never switch strata to fix an order; set a level. Exceptions: a strata the player chose, and a borrowed shared Blizzard frame lifted while shown and restored on hide to the value recorded on show.
conventions.reason: DropWatcher's Offer panel switches MEDIUM to DIALOG at runtime (DRO-S03). QuickComms LiftConfirm and PGFE PRE-Z03 show the safe lift pattern.

conventions.rule: Clamp popups as their roots are clamped, the library's own menus included.
conventions.reason: LOO-S09 (the library menu and autocomplete are unclamped). CON-S07 (unclamped flyout).

conventions.rule: Nothing invisible stays mouse-live. An alpha-0 soft-hidden frame is made mouse-dead. A secure child that cannot be is disarmed at PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED, or the residual is a documented deviation.
conventions.reason: WhatGroup's soft-hidden DIALOG popup eats clicks in combat (WHA-S01).

conventions.rule: Strata, level and toplevel writes on protected frames, or on frames that secure elements anchor to, go through the addon's secure queue and run out of combat.
conventions.reason: PFE's RunSecure("fade:strata") and ConsumableMaster's Create-time flyout strata. Writes are refused in combat.
